data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Aikathos, meaning pure or clean. In the New Testament, Katharina or Catherine is the name of a saint known for her purity and strength. The name Kathye carries the meaning “Pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kathye usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kathye belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kathye total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קתיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קתיה מקורו ביוונית ופירושו טהרה, שלמות, וקתרוס הקדוש. הוא קשור למושגים של טהרה רוחנית וקדושה בנצרות וביהדות.

in_greek.name: Καθυε
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καθυε προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη καθαρός, που σημαίνει καθαρότητα, αγιότητα και πνευματική τελειότητα. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την πνευματική κάθαρση και την προσήλωσή της ψυχής στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Cathye
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cathye originem ducit ex Graeco, significans puritatem, sanctitatem et integritatem. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen designat purificationem spiritualem et devotionem ad Deum.

Additionally, the name carries an elegant and feminine image, often associated with purity, refinement, and grace.
